title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Pie II
description: To make this guilt-free pie, reduced fat peanut butter, fat free chocolate pudding, and light whipped topping are mixed together and poured into a graham cracker crust and chilled.
ingredients: 2 (4 ounce) packages single serve ready-made, fat free, chocolate pudding
0.33300000429153 cup reduced fat smooth peanut butter
1 (8 ounce) container lite frozen whipped topping

steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine pudding and peanut butter; stir until smooth. Fold in whipped topping; stir until completely blended.

Pour filling into pie crust. Freeze pie until firm. Partially thaw in refrigerator, for about 2 hours or so, before serving. You can store leftovers in the refrigerator or freezer. Leftover pie sometimes gets a little soft in the refrigerator, and doesn't hold its shape. It still tastes good, though. If you want perfect looking slices after you make the first incision, store in freezer and thaw as needed.
